text:
Maria CSM: Heads-up — Compass is struggling with 429s during their demo this morning. They're asking for a short-lived throughput bump + header/IP allowlist so the sales demo and onboarding workshop don't hit errors.
Eli NetOps: Copy. Can you confirm source CIDRs and which regions to route? Also need duration and whether auto-revoke is OK.
Maria CSM: CIDR: 198.51.100.0/24 (primary demo cluster) + 2001:db8:abcd::/48 (backup). Regions: us-west1 for demo, ap-southeast1 for partner observers. Window: 3 hours from 16:00 PT, auto-revoke after window. Tag with renewal_risk:high so we prioritize logs.
Eli NetOps: Thanks. I can schedule a temporary rate-window and add both CIDRs to header allowlist. Will create egress peering ticket for ap-southeast1. ETA ~15m. @Deploy Bot can you create the infra ticket?
Deploy Bot: ticket# CS-8421 created — infra/egress-peering for ap-southeast1 and temporary rate-window. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-8421 :tada:
Sam AM: Noted — I'm on the renewal thread with Compass (renewing in 6w). This demo matters. Maria, can we capture post-demo NPS + whether throttling affected UX? I'll follow up in the customer debrief.
Jordan Support: I'll set up dashboards to monitor 429/5xx and tail errors for the window. Send me the API key tag you'll bump so I can filter.
Maria CSM: Using key: compass-demo-2026. Please don't expose the key publicly. We'll rotate after the window. Also capture sample failing prompts if any.
Grace Eng: Suggestion: add a fallback route to the smaller gpt-lite-serve model for non-critical traffic to preserve capacity. Config snippet we can apply on the routing layer:
```
route:
  match: header.x-customer == "compass"
  policy:
    - name: demo-bump
      override_rate_limit: 5rps
      regions: [us-west1, ap-southeast1]
    - name: fallback-cheap
      model: gpt-lite-serve
      when: token_cost > 200
```
Grace Eng: That will keep latencies low and reduce cost during the bump.
Eli NetOps: Applied CIDR allowlist and rate-window on the test key. Auto-revoke scheduled at 19:00 PT. Peering ticket created and assigned to @Eli NetOps. I'll post the peering ip once provisioned.
Jordan Support: Dashboards ready. Alert (pager) if 5xx > 0.5% or 429 > 3% across the window. Will annotate the timeline with CS-8421.
Maria CSM: Thanks team. I'll run enablement with Compass at 16:15 PT and confirm. Sam, please bring up renewal talking points if the demo goes well.
Sam AM: Will do. Also logging a quick customer health note: demo success needed to move renewal from at-risk -> on-track.
Maria CSM: Quick checklist: 
- [x] CIDRs added
- [x] Rate-window scheduled
- [x] Dashboards + alerts configured
- [x] Peering ticket opened (CS-8421)
- [ ] Post-demo NPS + error samples captured
Maria CSM: One more ask — can we tag logs with `customer:compass` and `demo-session:2026-03-23`? That'll help the CS playbook review.
Eli NetOps: Done. Tags applied at the ingress filter. I'll post the provisional peering IP once allocated.
Deploy Bot: CS-8421 updated with peering IP 34.102.56.10 and scheduled revert job at 19:00 PT.
Jordan Support: Adding follow-up task: collect top 10 prompts that retriggered 429s and send to eng QA for eval.
Grace Eng: If you send the prompts, we'll run quick evals and suggest prompt-level caching for repeated prefixes if pattern emerges.
Maria CSM: Appreciate it. Will capture feedback in the postmortem and include a renewal note. :thumbsup:
Sam AM: Thanks all. Hoping this turns the renewal conversation around. 
Maria CSM: Closing the loop here after the workshop. Will post outcome and NPS.
